items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
Minimum of 2 years of experience

Serve as Departmental Purchasing Card Administrator (DCA). Process approved ProCard purchases for the unit. Process transfers for purchases made by EEOB Lab Prep and Natural Reserve personnel and redistribute expenses to appropriate funding sources. (20% time)

Applies professional financial and accounting concepts to independently perform analyses of moderately complex financial services such as researching discrepancies and tax implications and compliance with external regulations and internal policies. Review and reconcile monthly general ledgers and payroll reports for various departments within the unit. Research items as needed to troubleshoot, clarify and verify. Review appropriateness of expenditures and identify inconsistencies. Coordinate any corrective actions with appropriate Analyst. Prepare statements as needed for unit and independently prepare cost transfers as needed by the department. (15% time)

Coordinates and monitors operations of functional area(s) which may include accounts payable, accounts receivable, purchasing, recharge billing, travel/entertainment, gift accounting, collections and/or cashiering, as assigned. (15% time)
Assists purchasing analyst with equipment management (10% time)
Submit work orders and facilities request and training compliance reports (10% time)
Submit snapshot request for new hires and separations, including position funding updates as assigned (10% time)
Manage Oracle Financial Supplier Portal (5% time)
Prepares reports and analyses to include summaries of financial transactions, evaluation of current and proposed services, et cetera, for management review and decision-making. (5% time)
Other duties as assigned (5% time)

Monitors the delivery of quality customer service to various constituencies to include internal department clients and external vendors. Assist with key distribution and inventory as needed. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Frequently
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Frequently
Communicate Orally: Frequently
Reason & Analyze: Frequently
Sit: Frequently
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Working knowledge of financial processes, policies and procedures.
Skills to provide coaching and mentoring to support staff.
Ability to adapt to changing priorities.
Demonstrated knowledge of UCR's financial systems and research applications

Strong interpersonal skills, analytical skills, service orientation, active listening, critical thinking, attention to detail, ability to multi-task in a high volume environment, organizational skills, effective verbal and written communication skills, sound judgment and decision making.
Intermediate knowledge and understanding of internal control practices and their impact on protecting University resources
Proficiency in the use of spreadsheet and database software.
Ability to function effectively as a member of a team.
Strong knowledge of financial data management and reporting systems.
